game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery, a ceiling of glowworms: the dwarf scout must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Loop Counter Conveyor: Count conveyor passes with a loop counter so exactly N items get processed.
theme: Shadow Cave – Glowworm Gallery: a ceiling of glowworms
